description: This Dart file defines the FirstScreen widget for a Flutter app, which is the initial screen shown to new users. It prompts for location and phone permissions, displays a themed UI with icons and text, and navigates to the SecondScreen upon permission approval. It also handles requesting permissions via the geolocator package and saves a preference indicating the first launch.

classes.name: FirstScreen
classes.description: StatefulWidget serving as the initial user interface, introducing permission requests and branding.

classes.name: _FirstScreenState
classes.description: State class managing UI state, permission flow, and navigation logic for FirstScreen.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the Flutter UI for the FirstScreen, including icons, texts, and permission buttons.

methods.name: _buildPermissionItem
methods.description: Creates a widget row with an icon and descriptive text for each permission type.

methods.name: _handleAllowPermissions
methods.description: Initiates permission request flow and updates UI state.

methods.name: _requestPermissionsAndNavigate
methods.description: Handles permission requests, saves preferences, and navigates to the next screen.
